modules.title: Listening Part A: Idioms, Negatives & Implied Meaning
modules.objective: Menangkap makna tersirat, ungkapan idiomatis, dan bentuk negatif ganda pada dialog singkat 2 pembicara.
modules.theory: Part A menguji pemahaman implikasi pembicara kedua dalam 2–3 giliran ucap. Jawaban benar umumnya merupakan parafrase makna, bukan pengulangan kata persis seperti rekaman. Fokus pada empat pola: (1) conditional contrary-to-fact (had I known...), (2) negative comparison (couldn't be better), (3) phrasal/idiomatic verbs (call it a day, brush up on), dan (4) polite refusal atau suggestion (Why don't we...?).
modules.workedExample: Woman: 'Are you joining the chemistry study group tonight?' | Man: 'I wish I could, but my lab report is due at eight tomorrow.' | Jawaban: He cannot attend because he must complete an assignment.
modules.commonMistake: Memilih opsi yang mengulang kata 'chemistry' atau 'eight' namun membalik status kehadiran pembicara.
modules.audioScript: W: Are you joining the chemistry study group tonight? M: I wish I could, but my lab report is due at eight tomorrow.

drills.prompt: Man: 'The library annex is packed.' Woman: 'Tell me about it! I spent twenty minutes looking for a single outlet.' — What does the woman mean?
options: She completely agrees that the annex is crowded.
She wants the man to explain where the outlets are.
She waited twenty minutes to speak with a librarian.
She prefers studying outside the library annex.
drills.answer: She completely agrees that the annex is crowded.
drills.explanation: 'Tell me about it' adalah idiom persetujuan kuat terhadap keluhan pembicara pertama.

drills.prompt: Woman: 'Did Professor Sato postpone the midterm?' Man: 'If only she had!' — What does the man imply?
options: The midterm was not postponed.
Professor Sato only tests one chapter.
The man already finished the exam.
The exam moved to next week.
drills.answer: The midterm was not postponed.
drills.explanation: Konstruksi 'If only + past perfect' mengungkapkan penyesalan terhadap fakta yang tidak terjadi (ujian tetap berlangsung).

drills.prompt: Man: 'Should I rewrite the entire introduction?' Woman: 'No need to start from scratch—just tighten the thesis.' — What does the woman suggest?
options: Keep most of the introduction and revise the thesis statement.
Delete the draft and begin a new topic.
Ask another student to edit the paper.
Submit the draft without making any edits.
drills.answer: Keep most of the introduction and revise the thesis statement.
drills.explanation: 'Start from scratch' berarti mengulang dari nol; 'No need to' menolak keharusan menulis ulang semuanya.

modules.title: Listening Part B & C: Extended Dialogues & Academic Lectures
modules.objective: Mengidentifikasi topik utama, relasi sebab-akibat, dan detail berurutan dalam percakapan panjang serta kuliah singkat.
modules.theory: Dua kalimat awal rekaman Part B/C hampir selalu memperkenalkan topik dan konteks pembicara. Pertanyaan tersusun kronologis mengikuti jalannya audio. Catat penanda transisi seperti 'first', 'however', 'in contrast', dan 'for instance' untuk mengantisipasi butir pertanyaan berikutnya.
modules.workedExample: Lecturer: 'Unlike broad-leafed trees, desert succulents retain moisture inside thick stems and open stomata only at night.' -> Pertanyaan alasan adaptasi berfokus pada pengurangan penguapan siang hari.
modules.commonMistake: Terhenti memikirkan satu istilah ilmiah yang tidak familiar hingga tertinggal jawaban nomor berikutnya.
modules.audioScript: Today we compare two passive cooling methods used in historic courtyard houses: thermal mass walls and shaded water basins.

drills.prompt: In an opening lecture: 'Before synthetic dyes transformed textiles in 1856, weavers depended on crushed insects, roots, and minerals.' What will the talk most likely focus on next?
options: Natural sources used for early fabric coloring
Modern factory pollution controls
How synthetic fibers resist sunlight
Trade disputes over cotton prices
drills.answer: Natural sources used for early fabric coloring
drills.explanation: Kalimat pembuka menempatkan fokus pada bahan pewarna alami sebelum penemuan pewarna sintetis.

drills.prompt: Advisor: 'Because your internship runs Mondays and Wednesdays, the Tuesday morning seminar fits best without delaying graduation.' Why does the advisor recommend Tuesday's seminar?
options: It avoids schedule conflicts and keeps the student on track.
It requires fewer credits than other seminars.
It takes place at the same site as the internship.
It is only offered during summer sessions.
drills.answer: It avoids schedule conflicts and keeps the student on track.
drills.explanation: 'Fits best without delaying graduation' langsung merujuk jadwal bebas bentrok sekaligus memenuhi syarat kelulusan.

drills.prompt: Lecturer: 'Notice that clay tablets survived thousands of years precisely because accidental fires baked them rock-hard.' What preserved the tablets?
options: Heat from fires hardened the clay.
Scribes coated them in protective wax.
Dry desert winds prevented erosion.
Storage inside stone vaults kept them dry.
drills.answer: Heat from fires hardened the clay.
drills.explanation: Penanda sebab 'precisely because' menunjuk langsung pada pembakaran akibat kebakaran.

modules.title: Structure: Clauses, Inversion & Subject-Verb Agreement
modules.objective: Melengkapi struktur kalimat akademik dengan subjek, kata kerja utama, klausa relatif, dan inversi yang tepat.
modules.theory: Langkah cepat Structure (1–15): (1) Pisahkan frasa preposisi dan appositive antara koma agar inti Subject + Verb terlihat. (2) Periksa jumlah klausa: N klausa membutuhkan N-1 konektor yang tepat. (3) Jika kalimat diawali ekspresi negatif (Never, Rarely, Seldom, Not only, Only by...), gunakan inversi Auxiliary + Subject + Verb.
modules.workedExample: 'Seldom ___ such rapid coastal sedimentation in a single season.' -> 'have researchers documented'.
modules.commonMistake: Lupa melakukan inversi setelah kata keterangan negatif di awal kalimat.

drills.prompt: Not until the eighteenth century ___ reliable marine chronometers for measuring longitude.
options: did clockmakers build
clockmakers built
built clockmakers
were clockmakers built
drills.answer: did clockmakers build
drills.explanation: 'Not until...' di awal kalimat mewajibkan inversi auxiliary 'did' + subject + bare infinitive.

drills.prompt: The museum's collection of ceramic vessels, along with several Bronze Age tools, ___ displayed in the east wing.
options: is
are
were
have been
drills.answer: is
drills.explanation: Inti subjek tunggal adalah 'collection'; frasa 'along with...' tidak mengubah jumlah subjek.

drills.prompt: ___ from volcanic ash, obsidian fractures into edges sharper than surgical steel.
options: Formed
Forming
It forms
To form it
drills.answer: Formed
drills.explanation: Reduced passive participle clause ('When it is formed from volcanic ash...') merujuk subjek 'obsidian'.

modules.title: Written Expression: Word Forms, Pronouns & Comparisons
modules.objective: Mengidentifikasi kesalahan tata bahasa bertanda [A]–[D] pada kelas kata, rujukan pronomina, preposisi, dan paralelisme.
modules.theory: Written Expression (16–40) memeriksa ketelitian morfologi dan kohesi: (1) noun vs adjective vs adverb (economic vs economical; rapid vs rapidly), (2) kesesuaian pronoun dengan antecedent (its vs their), (3) paralelisme elemen setara (gerund dengan gerund, noun dengan noun), (4) preposisi dan perbandingan standar (more durable than, similar to, capable of).
modules.workedExample: 'The archive [A] houses maps, [B] each of which [C] require [D] careful humidity control.' -> [C] require -> requires (each tunggal).
modules.commonMistake: Mengacu pada kata benda jamak terdekat alih-alih kata inti frasa seperti 'each', 'one', atau 'the number of'.

drills.prompt: Solar panels [A] convert sunlight [B] direct into electricity [C] without using [D] moving parts.
options: [A] convert
[B] direct
[C] without using
[D] moving parts
drills.answer: [B] direct
drills.explanation: Diperlukan adverb 'directly' untuk memodifikasi kata kerja 'convert'.

drills.prompt: Each [A] of the [B] newly installed seismographs [C] transmit real-time tremors to [D] the regional hub.
options: [A] of
[B] newly installed
[C] transmit
[D] the regional hub
drills.answer: [C] transmit
drills.explanation: Subjek tunggal 'Each' membutuhkan kata kerja tunggal 'transmits'.

drills.prompt: Migratory cranes [A] navigate across continents by [B] tracking coastlines, [C] reading star patterns, and [D] they sense magnetic fields.
options: [A] navigate
[B] tracking
[C] reading
[D] they sense
drills.answer: [D] they sense
drills.explanation: Paralelisme setelah preposisi 'by' menuntut bentuk gerund 'sensing', bukan klausa baru 'they sense'.

modules.title: Reading Comprehension: Main Idea, Inference & Vocabulary
modules.objective: Menentukan gagasan utama, sinonim kontekstual, rujukan pronomina, dan inferensi berbasis teks akademik.
modules.theory: Baca kalimat pertama tiap paragraf untuk memetakan struktur teks sebelum masuk ke soal detail. Pada soal kosakata-dalam-konteks, uji substitusi makna ke kalimat asli agar kelas kata dan logika cocok. Untuk inferensi, hindari klaim ekstrem ('all', 'never', 'solely') yang melampaui bukti bacaan.
modules.workedExample: 'Because tidal mills depended on lunar cycles, bakers adapted work hours to high tide.' -> Inferensi sah: jadwal kerja bergeser tiap hari mengikuti pasang surut.
modules.commonMistake: Memilih definisi kamus yang paling sering dipakai walau bertentangan dengan konteks kalimat.

drills.prompt: Excerpt: 'Although early electric streetcars were virtually silent, critics warned that overhead cables would clutter city skylines.' What does 'virtually' mean here?
options: almost completely
artificially
temporarily
digitally
drills.answer: almost completely
drills.explanation: Dalam prosa akademik, 'virtually' sebelum adjektiva bermakna 'nearly / almost completely'.

drills.prompt: Excerpt: 'Beavers build dams that slow spring runoff; these barriers trap sediment and create wetlands.' What does 'these barriers' refer to?
options: dams
beavers
wetlands
runoff
drills.answer: dams
drills.explanation: Demonstratif 'these barriers' merujuk langsung pada objek fisik 'dams' pada klausa sebelumnya.

drills.prompt: Excerpt: 'Seed banks store duplicates in permafrost vaults because mechanical freezers remain vulnerable to prolonged power outages.' Why are permafrost vaults used?
options: They preserve low temperatures even if electricity fails.
They germinate seeds faster than laboratory trays.
They eliminate the need to catalog plant species.
They prevent moisture from ever freezing.
drills.answer: They preserve low temperatures even if electricity fails.
drills.explanation: Kontras terhadap kerentanan freezer mekanis terhadap pemadaman listrik menunjuk ketahanan suhu alami permafrost.

modules.title: ITP Level 1 Pacing & Non-Penalty Answering Strategy
modules.objective: Mengatur ritme 35m Listening, 25m Structure, dan 55m Reading tanpa meninggalkan nomor kosong.
modules.theory: TOEFL ITP tidak mengenakan penalti untuk jawaban salah. Pastikan setiap butir terisi sebelum waktu habis. Di Structure, targetkan <=35 detik per nomor agar tersisa waktu memeriksa Written Expression. Di Reading (5 teks / 50 soal / 55 menit), jatah maksimal ~10–11 menit per bacaan.
modules.workedExample: Tandai soal inferensi panjang dengan Flag lalu kerjakan soal kosakata & pronoun reference terlebih dahulu untuk mengunci poin cepat.
modules.commonMistake: Menghabiskan 5 menit pada satu soal Reading sulit hingga mengorbankan 8 soal mudah di teks terakhir.

drills.prompt: With 90 seconds remaining in ITP Reading and 4 unanswered items, what is the optimal action?
options: Fill in reasonable answers for all 4 items because wrong answers carry no penalty.
Leave uncertain items blank so accuracy percentage is higher.
Spend the final 90 seconds rereading the entire passage from line 1.
Skip to the end without selecting any option.
drills.answer: Fill in reasonable answers for all 4 items because wrong answers carry no penalty.
drills.explanation: Skor ITP dihitung dari jumlah jawaban benar tanpa pengurangan poin.

drills.prompt: Which skill sections belong to a standard TOEFL ITP Level 1 core examination?
options: Listening Comprehension, Structure & Written Expression, and Reading Comprehension
Reading, Listening, Integrated Speaking, and Essay Writing
Listening, Reading, Writing Task 1, and Speaking Part 2
Vocabulary Only and Grammar Dictation
drills.answer: Listening Comprehension, Structure & Written Expression, and Reading Comprehension
drills.explanation: TOEFL ITP Level 1 menguji Listening (50), Structure & Written Expression (40), dan Reading (50).

drills.prompt: During Listening Part A, what should you do once you select an answer?
options: Shift attention immediately to the next spoken item.
Continue re-checking previous grammar items.
Wait for the speaker to repeat the dialogue twice.
Skip the narrator's question.
drills.answer: Shift attention immediately to the next spoken item.
drills.explanation: Rekaman ITP hanya diputar satu kali dengan jeda singkat antar soal.

modules.title: iBT 2026 Reading: Complete the Words & Read in Daily Life
modules.objective: Melengkapi rumpang morfologis/kontekstual (Complete the Words) dan mengekstrak aturan/tenggat pada teks fungsional harian.
modules.theory: Mulai 21 Januari 2026, TOEFL iBT memasukkan tugas 'Complete the Words' (mengisi huruf/kata rumpang dalam paragraf pendek) serta 'Read in Daily Life' (pengumuman, email, jadwal kampus, formulir kebijakan). Cermati part of speech, imbuhan kata kerja/nomina, serta kata syarat seperti 'unless', 'prior to', dan 'exempt'.
modules.workedExample: 'All lab users must sub___ safety logs before Friday.' -> 'submit' (transitif setelah modal 'must').
modules.commonMistake: Menuliskan bentuk nomina ('submission') atau lampau ('submitted') pada posisi verb dasar.

drills.prompt: Complete the word in context: 'Campus shuttle buses will run on an ext_____ schedule during final exam week.' (Type the full word)
drills.answer: extended
acceptedAnswers: extended
drills.explanation: Adjektiva 'extended' berarti jadwal diperpanjang selama pekan ujian.

drills.prompt: Notice: 'Library lockers expire May 18. Items left after May 20 are donated unless students request a 7-day extension by email.' How can a student keep items until May 25?
options: Email the library to request a 7-day extension before items are donated.
Leave a handwritten note inside the locker on May 21.
Pay a daily fee at the main desk on May 25.
Extensions are never granted during May.
drills.answer: Email the library to request a 7-day extension before items are donated.
drills.explanation: Teks menyatakan syarat eksplisit: 'unless students request a 7-day extension by email'.

drills.prompt: Complete the word: 'Volunteers will dis_______ reusable water bottles at the orientation booth.' (Type the full word)
drills.answer: distribute
acceptedAnswers: distribute
drills.explanation: Setelah modal 'will', dibutuhkan kata kerja dasar 'distribute'.

modules.title: iBT 2026 Reading: Academic Passages & Rhetorical Purpose
modules.objective: Mengevaluasi tujuan retoris penulis, klaim empiris, dan hubungan logis dalam bacaan akademik modern.
modules.theory: Tugas Read an Academic Passage menuntut pembacaan hubungan antar-ide, bukan sekadar mencocokkan kata kunci. Ketika ditanya 'Why does the author mention X?', baca 1 kalimat sebelum X karena X hampir selalu berperan sebagai bukti, pengecualian, atau perbandingan bagi klaim utama paragraf.
modules.workedExample: Klaim: 'Soil fungi accelerate forest recovery.' -> Kalimat berikut menyebut 'pine seedlings paired with mycorrhizal networks grew 40% taller.' -> Fungsi: memberi bukti kuantitatif.
modules.commonMistake: Memilih opsi yang sekadar merangkum fakta 'pine seedlings' tanpa menjelaskan fungsinya mendukung klaim.

drills.prompt: Passage: 'Urban heat islands raise nighttime temperatures. For instance, dense asphalt plazas retain solar heat hours after sunset.' Why does the author mention dense asphalt plazas?
options: To provide a concrete mechanism illustrating why urban areas stay warm at night
To argue that cities should ban all paved sidewalks
To prove rural farms cool down slower than plazas
To question whether thermometers are accurate in cities
drills.answer: To provide a concrete mechanism illustrating why urban areas stay warm at night
drills.explanation: Frasa 'For instance' menandai ilustrasi/contoh konkret bagi klaim sebelumnya.

drills.prompt: Passage: 'Early models assumed birds navigated solely by visual landmarks; however, overcast trials showed homing pigeons still oriented accurately.' What did overcast trials demonstrate?
options: Visual landmarks alone cannot explain pigeon navigation.
Pigeons refuse to fly under cloudy skies.
Early navigation models were completely accurate.
Wind speed determines homing direction.
drills.answer: Visual landmarks alone cannot explain pigeon navigation.
drills.explanation: Penanda kontras 'however' membantah asumsi 'solely by visual landmarks'.

drills.prompt: Which statement best describes the tone of a passage comparing two competing battery chemistries using peer-reviewed cycle counts?
options: Analytical and evidence-based
Sarcastic and dismissive
Nostalgic and informal
Promotional and exaggerated
drills.answer: Analytical and evidence-based
drills.explanation: Perbandingan data empiris dari publikasi ilmiah menunjukkan nada analitis objektif.

modules.title: iBT 2026 Listening: Choose a Response, Conversations & Announcements
modules.objective: Memahami maksud pragmatis dalam respon singkat, perubahan jadwal/kebijakan pengumuman, dan dialog kampus.
modules.theory: Tugas 'Listen and Choose a Response' menguji kesesuaian sosial dan pragmatik bahasa Inggris kampus (permintaan izin, konfirmasi, keluhan, penawaran bantuan). Pada pengumuman kampus, perhatikan apa yang berubah, siapa yang terdampak, dan tindakan lanjutan.
modules.workedExample: Audio: 'Would you mind switching shifts on Thursday?' -> Jawaban tepat menolak/menerima tanpa kebingungan 'mind' ('Not at all, Thursday afternoon works for me').
modules.commonMistake: Salah menafsirkan pertanyaan negatif ('Do you mind if...') dengan menjawab 'Yes' padahal bermaksud mengizinkan.
modules.audioScript: M: Would you mind swapping lab shifts on Thursday? W: Not at all. Thursday afternoon actually fits my schedule better.

drills.prompt: Speaker says: 'I didn't catch the room number for Friday's workshop—was it 302 or 312?' Choose the best natural response.
options: It was moved to 312 because 302 is under repair.
Yes, I attend workshops every Friday morning.
I already caught the campus shuttle at three.
You can bring a notebook and a pencil.
drills.answer: It was moved to 312 because 302 is under repair.
drills.explanation: Respons langsung menjawab konfirmasi nomor ruang secara alami dan informatif.

drills.prompt: Announcement: 'Due to roof maintenance, the North Studio will close at 4 PM today. Ceramics lockers remain accessible via the courtyard ramp.' What remains open?
options: Access to ceramics lockers via the courtyard ramp
The North Studio painting hall until midnight
Roof observation decks for students
Main lobby printing kiosks inside North Studio
drills.answer: Access to ceramics lockers via the courtyard ramp
drills.explanation: Pengumuman secara eksplisit mengecualikan akses loker keramik melalui jalur halaman.

drills.prompt: Speaker says: 'Could you share the slides from yesterday's seminar?' Best response if you agree:
options: Sure, I will email you the PDF right after lunch.
No, yesterday's seminar lasted ninety minutes.
That slide projector belongs to the dean.
I rarely sit near the front row.
drills.answer: Sure, I will email you the PDF right after lunch.
drills.explanation: Menjawab permintaan berbagi materi dengan persetujuan dan waktu pengiriman jelas.

modules.title: iBT 2026 Listening: Academic Talks & Note-Taking
modules.objective: Menangkap struktur kuliah singkat iBT 2026, hubungan antar-konsep, dan fungsi penanda wacana dosen.
modules.theory: Kuliah akademik iBT 2026 lebih ringkas namun padat informasi. Gunakan simbol panah (->), kontras (vs), dan tanda bintang (*) saat dosen memperkenalkan pengecualian teori atau temuan terbaru.
modules.workedExample: Dosen: 'Notice that tree rings don't just show age—wide rings reflect wet years, while tight bands record drought.' -> Catat: wide=wet, tight=drought.
modules.commonMistake: Mencatat kalimat panjang kata demi kata sehingga kehilangan ide pembicara berikutnya.
modules.audioScript: Notice that tree rings record more than age. Wide rings reflect abundant rainfall, whereas tightly compressed bands indicate prolonged drought.

drills.prompt: Lecturer says: 'Hold on—before we praise dams for flood control, look at what happens to downstream deltas starved of silt.' What is the lecturer doing?
options: Introducing an unintended negative consequence
Summarizing engineering blueprints for a new dam
Dismissing river flooding as unimportant
Changing the exam date for geology students
drills.answer: Introducing an unintended negative consequence
drills.explanation: Penanda 'Hold on—before we praise...' menandai pergeseran ke dampak negatif yang sering terlewat.

drills.prompt: In a talk on bioluminescence: 'Deep-sea anglerfish host glowing bacteria in a lure rather than producing light themselves.' How does the fish glow?
options: Through symbiotic light-emitting bacteria
By reflecting moonlight down to the seafloor
Through electric sparks along its fins
By storing fluorescent algae in its scales
drills.answer: Through symbiotic light-emitting bacteria
drills.explanation: Ikan tidak memproduksi cahaya sendiri melainkan menampung bakteri bercahaya.

drills.prompt: Which note-taking habit best supports Academic Talk comprehension?
options: Mapping key terms, comparisons, and cause-effect arrows briefly
Writing down every spoken preposition verbatim
Waiting until the talk ends before writing anything
Memorizing only speaker names without concepts
drills.answer: Mapping key terms, comparisons, and cause-effect arrows briefly
drills.explanation: Catatan simbolis menjaga fokus pada alur gagasan dan relasi logis.

modules.title: iBT 2026 Writing: Build a Sentence, Write an Email & Academic Discussion
modules.objective: Menyusun kalimat utuh dari potongan kata, menulis email fungsional efektif, dan menyumbang argumen diskusi akademik.
modules.theory: Format Writing iBT 2026 terdiri atas 3 tugas: (1) Build a Sentence: perhatikan urutan embedded question (Wh + S + V) dan posisi modifier; (2) Write an Email: langsung ke tujuan, penuhi seluruh poin prompt dengan nada sopan; (3) Academic Discussion: tulis ~100–130 kata merespons topik dosen & rekan kelas dengan alasan spesifik.
modules.workedExample: Fragments: ['explain', 'did', 'why', 'the', 'closed', 'museum', 'was'] -> 'Did she explain why the museum was closed?' (urutan S+V pada klausa why).
modules.commonMistake: Menggunakan inversi tanya di dalam embedded clause ('why was the museum closed').

drills.prompt: Arrange all fragments to form a grammatical question: 'Do you know ___?'
options: when
the
chemistry
tutor
arrives
drills.answer: when|the|chemistry|tutor|arrives
drills.explanation: Embedded question setelah 'Do you know' memakai urutan S + V ('when the chemistry tutor arrives').

drills.prompt: Which opening sentence is clearest for a formal email requesting a rescheduled lab briefing?
options: Dear Dr. Patel, I am writing to request an alternative time for Tuesday's safety briefing because my field survey overlaps with it.
Hey Patel! Stuff came up Tuesday so maybe do the lab thing later?
Safety briefings are very important in science and everyone likes them.
I hope your weekend was nice; anyway, goodbye.
drills.answer: Dear Dr. Patel, I am writing to request an alternative time for Tuesday's safety briefing because my field survey overlaps with it.
drills.explanation: Email efektif langsung menyebut sapaan sopan, tujuan spesifik, dan alasan singkat.

drills.prompt: In an Academic Discussion post (~110 words), what strengthens your contribution most?
options: Stating a clear stance, referencing a peer's point, and adding one original example
Copying the professor's prompt sentence three times to increase word count
Listing single keywords without complete sentences
Using slang abbreviations instead of academic phrasing
drills.answer: Stating a clear stance, referencing a peer's point, and adding one original example
drills.explanation: Rubrik Academic Discussion menilai keterkaitan argumen terhadap diskusi kelas dan elaborasi orisinal.

modules.title: iBT 2026 Speaking: Listen & Repeat dan Take an Interview
modules.objective: Melatih pengulangan kalimat akurat (Listen & Repeat) dan jawaban wawancara spontan terstruktur (Take an Interview).
modules.theory: Pada 'Listen and Repeat', kelompokkan kalimat panjang menjadi frasa makna (chunking) dan jaga penekanan kata kunci. Pada 'Take an Interview', jawab tiap pertanyaan pewawancara dengan pola 3 langkah: Direct Answer -> Reason -> Concrete Example dalam ~40 detik.
modules.workedExample: Prompt: 'Please bring your student ID card to the registration desk before nine.' -> Chunk 1: 'Please bring your student ID card' | Chunk 2: 'to the registration desk' | Chunk 3: 'before nine.'
modules.commonMistake: Berhenti terlalu lama di tengah kalimat saat lupa satu kata minor sehingga intonasi putus.
modules.audioScript: Please bring your student ID card to the registration desk before nine.

drills.prompt: During 'Listen and Repeat', if you stumble slightly on one word mid-sentence, what is best?
options: Keep steady pacing and complete the remaining phrase cleanly.
Stop speaking entirely for ten seconds.
Restart the entire sentence three times until time expires.
Whisper unrelated words to fill the silence.
drills.answer: Keep steady pacing and complete the remaining phrase cleanly.
drills.explanation: Kelancaran alami dan penyelesaian frasa utama lebih penting daripada mengulang panik.

drills.prompt: What structure makes a 40-second 'Take an Interview' answer easy for raters to follow?
options: Direct claim -> one supporting reason -> one brief concrete example
Long background history without ever stating an opinion
Listing ten disconnected adjectives
Repeating the interviewer's question word for word twice
drills.answer: Direct claim -> one supporting reason -> one brief concrete example
drills.explanation: Alur Claim-Reason-Example menjaga kejelasan koherensi dalam waktu singkat.

drills.prompt: How is the overall TOEFL iBT score reported under the post-January 2026 format?
options: On a 1–6 scale alongside transitional 0–120 comparability guidance
Strictly on the 310–677 TOEFL ITP paper scale
As Pass/Fail with no section subscores
Using a 10–90 scale like PTE
drills.answer: On a 1–6 scale alongside transitional 0–120 comparability guidance
drills.explanation: Format iBT 2026 memakai skala band 1–6 (dengan masa transisi referensi 0–120).

modules.title: IELTS Listening Parts 1–4: Form Limits & Self-Correction Traps
modules.objective: Menangkap angka, ejaan nama/alamat, serta jebakan koreksi diri pembicara sambil mematuhi batas kata.
modules.theory: IELTS Listening terdiri dari 4 bagian (40 soal, ~30 menit). Aturan batas kata seperti 'NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER' wajib dipatuhi mutlak. Waspadai distractor self-correction ('Let's book Tuesday—oh wait, Dr. Kim is away, make it Thursday'). Perhatikan kata kerja/jamak setelah rumpang agar bentuk singular/plural tepat.
modules.workedExample: Audio: 'Our deposit is thirty pounds—sorry, that increased this month to thirty-five pounds.' -> Jawaban: '35' (bukan 30).
modules.commonMistake: Menulis jawaban lebih dari batas kata atau langsung mencatat angka pertama sebelum pembicara selesai kalimat.
modules.audioScript: Clerk: The studio deposit was thirty pounds last semester, oh sorry, that rate updated to thirty-five pounds this month.

drills.prompt: Instruction: NO MORE THAN ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER. Audio says: 'Originally we scheduled the field walk for 14 May, no wait, the bus is booked, so let's confirm 21 May.' Date: ___ May
acceptedAnswers: 21st
twenty-one
drills.explanation: Pembicara meralat tanggal 14 menjadi 21 May.

drills.prompt: Instruction: ONE WORD ONLY. Audio says: 'Visitors must store large rucksacks inside the ground-floor ___ before entering the reading room.'
drills.answer: lockers
acceptedAnswers: lockers
locker
drills.explanation: Kata benda jamak 'lockers' cocok secara gramatikal dan konteks penyimpanan tas.

drills.prompt: If a prompt instructs 'NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS', what happens if you write 'the main entrance'?
options: It is marked incorrect because it contains three words.
The examiner ignores 'the' automatically.
It receives half credit.
It is accepted if spelled accurately.
drills.answer: It is marked incorrect because it contains three words.
drills.explanation: Artikel 'the' tetap dihitung sebagai 1 kata; melebihi batas kata membuat jawaban salah.

modules.title: IELTS Reading: True / False / Not Given Logic
modules.objective: Membedakan secara presisi antara kontradiksi fakta (FALSE) dan ketiadaan bukti dalam bacaan (NOT GIVEN).
modules.theory: Aturan emas TFNG / YNNG: TRUE = seluruh elemen pernyataan didukung teks (umumnya diparafrase). FALSE = teks secara eksplisit menyatakan fakta yang berlawanan atau mustahil berdampingan dengan pernyataan. NOT GIVEN = teks tidak mengonfirmasi maupun membantah klaim spesifik (mis. perbandingan 'more than' atau niat yang tidak ditulis).
modules.workedExample: Teks: 'Electric ferries cut harbor diesel use by 60%.' Pernyataan: 'Electric ferries eliminated 100% of harbor pollution.' -> FALSE (bertentangan; hanya 60% pengurangan diesel, bukan 100%).
modules.commonMistake: Menjawab FALSE padahal teks hanya tidak menyebut informasi pembanding sama sekali (seharusnya NOT GIVEN).

drills.prompt: Text: 'Archeologists recovered twelve bronze coins from the northern courtyard in 2019.' Statement: 'The twelve coins were minted by Roman merchants.' -> TRUE, FALSE, or NOT GIVEN?
options: TRUE
FALSE
NOT GIVEN
drills.answer: NOT GIVEN
drills.explanation: Teks menyebut jumlah koin dan lokasi temuan, namun tidak memberi informasi siapa pencetak koinnya.

drills.prompt: Text: 'Unlike older glass thermometers, infrared sensors measure surface temperature without physical contact.' Statement: 'Infrared sensors require direct physical touch to record temperature.' -> TRUE, FALSE, or NOT GIVEN?
options: TRUE
FALSE
NOT GIVEN
drills.answer: FALSE
drills.explanation: Teks secara langsung menyatakan pengukuran dilakukan 'without physical contact', bertentangan dengan 'require direct physical touch'.

drills.prompt: Text: 'Nearly all participants reported improved sleep within three weeks of dimming bedroom screens.' Statement: 'Most participants experienced better sleep after reducing evening screen brightness.' -> TRUE, FALSE, or NOT GIVEN?
options: TRUE
FALSE
NOT GIVEN
drills.answer: TRUE
drills.explanation: 'Nearly all' sesuai dengan 'Most', dan 'improved sleep' memparafrasekan 'better sleep'.

modules.title: IELTS Reading: Matching Headings & Summary Completion
modules.objective: Menangkap ide sentral paragraf untuk Matching Headings dan menjaga akurasi tata bahasa pada Summary Completion.
modules.theory: Untuk Matching Headings, baca keseluruhan paragraf untuk menangkap pesan utama, bukan mencari 1 kata yang sama persis dengan opsi heading (jebakan keyword-matching). Untuk Summary Completion, pastikan kata yang disisipkan memenuhi batas kata sekaligus sesuai jenis kata (singular/plural/participle).
modules.workedExample: Paragraf menguraikan mengapa proyek kanal abad ke-19 gagal karena kebocoran kapur dan anggaran membengkak -> Heading tepat: 'Geological and financial obstacles to early construction'.
modules.commonMistake: Memilih heading hanya karena satu contoh kecil di akhir paragraf.

drills.prompt: A paragraph opens by noting tidal turbines disrupt fish rarely, then spends five sentences explaining maintenance corrosion in saltwater and high repair boat costs. Best heading?
options: Operational challenges in marine environments
Why marine mammals prefer coastal turbines
Government subsidies for inland wind farms
A history of nineteenth-century shipyards
drills.answer: Operational challenges in marine environments
drills.explanation: Mayoritas paragraf membahas korosi air laut dan biaya kapal perbaikan (tantangan operasional).

drills.prompt: Summary (ONE WORD ONLY from text): Text states 'Mangrove roots trap suspended mud, gradually raising shoreline elevation.' Summary: 'By capturing floating mud, mangroves slowly increase coastal ___.'
drills.answer: elevation
acceptedAnswers: elevation
drills.explanation: Setelah adjektiva 'coastal', dibutuhkan kata benda 'elevation' dari kalimat sumber.

drills.prompt: In IELTS Reading Matching Features (matching researchers to claims), why should you scan for proper names first?
options: Capitalized researcher names stand out rapidly and anchor exact paragraphs.
Questions always follow strict alphabetical order of names.
Each researcher always receives exactly two questions.
Proper names never appear inside quotations.
drills.answer: Capitalized researcher names stand out rapidly and anchor exact paragraphs.
drills.explanation: Huruf kapital mempercepat pemindaian lokasi temuan tiap peneliti di teks.

modules.title: IELTS Writing Task 1 Academic: Overview, Trends & Comparisons
modules.objective: Menyusun laporan data objektif >=150 kata dengan paragraf Overview jelas dan komparasi angka yang akurat.
modules.theory: Task 1 Academic (20 menit, min. 150 kata) menilai 4 kriteria: Task Achievement (TA), Coherence & Cohesion (CC), Lexical Resource (LR), Grammatical Range & Accuracy (GRA). Struktur wajib: (1) Paraphrase intro, (2) Overview 2–3 kecenderungan utama TANPA angka rinci, (3) Body 1 & Body 2 mengelompokkan kategori secara logis dengan angka tepat.
modules.workedExample: Overview kuat: 'Overall, renewable electricity expanded steadily across all three regions, whereas coal output declined sharply after 2015.'
modules.commonMistake: Tidak menulis paragraf Overview atau menyisipkan opini pribadi mengenai penyebab tren di luar grafik.

drills.prompt: Which sentence belongs in an IELTS Writing Task 1 Overview paragraph?
options: Overall, rail ridership rose across the decade while domestic air travel peaked mid-period before declining.
In my opinion, governments should invest more in high-speed trains to cut emissions.
Rail ridership was 42.3 million in 2012, 44.1 million in 2013, and 45.8 million in 2014.
This chart proves trains are better than planes.
drills.answer: Overall, rail ridership rose across the decade while domestic air travel peaked mid-period before declining.
drills.explanation: Overview merangkum tren besar secara objektif tanpa daftar angka mentah atau opini pribadi.

drills.prompt: What is the minimum recommended word count for IELTS Writing Task 1?
options: 150 words
100 words
250 words
80 words
drills.answer: 150 words
drills.explanation: IELTS Task 1 mensyaratkan minimal 150 kata.

drills.prompt: When describing a manufacturing process diagram, which grammar feature helps Task Achievement & GRA most?
options: Sequencing linkers (Initially, Subsequently) combined with passive voice where the agent is unimportant
First-person storytelling ('Yesterday I visited a factory')
Bullet points instead of connected paragraphs
Hypothetical guesses about factory profits
drills.answer: Sequencing linkers (Initially, Subsequently) combined with passive voice where the agent is unimportant
drills.explanation: Diagram proses mendeskripsikan tahapan berurutan secara objektif menggunakan passive voice dan penanda urutan.

modules.title: IELTS Writing Task 2 Academic: Essay Coherence & Band 7+ Precision
modules.objective: Menulis esai argumentatif >=250 kata yang menjawab seluruh bagian pertanyaan dengan posisi konsisten dan kohesi alami.
modules.theory: Task 2 berbobot 2/3 nilai Writing (40 menit, min. 250 kata). Pastikan seluruh sisi pertanyaan terjawab (mis. kedua pandangan pada 'Discuss both views and give your own opinion'). Kembangkan tiap paragraf tubuh secara utuh: Topic Sentence -> Mechanism/Reason -> Concrete Illustration -> Mini-link to thesis.
modules.workedExample: Prompt: 'Some argue public museums should charge zero admission, while others favor tickets.' -> Body 1: manfaat akses gratis; Body 2: keberlanjutan pendanaan + posisi penulis.
modules.commonMistake: Menulis paragraf berisi 4 gagasan dangkal tanpa penjelasan mekanisme sebab-akibat.

drills.prompt: Prompt: 'Discuss both views and give your opinion.' Which structure meets Task Response completely?
options: Intro with clear thesis -> Body 1 (View A) -> Body 2 (View B + reasoned stance) -> Conclusion
Intro -> Three paragraphs supporting only View A -> Conclusion
Listing pros and cons in bullet form without an opinion
Writing 160 words without topic sentences
drills.answer: Intro with clear thesis -> Body 1 (View A) -> Body 2 (View B + reasoned stance) -> Conclusion
drills.explanation: Seluruh komponen prompt (kedua pandangan dan opini penulis) wajib tercakup jelas.

drills.prompt: Which sentence demonstrates natural academic lexical precision without forced memorized idioms?
options: Subsidizing regional rail lines can curb commuter car reliance and ease highway congestion.
Every coin has two sides in this modern fast-paced world nowadays.
Public transport is a double-edged sword that goes without saying.
In a nutshell, trains are good because good things happen.
drills.answer: Subsidizing regional rail lines can curb commuter car reliance and ease highway congestion.
drills.explanation: Kolokasi tepat ('curb reliance', 'ease congestion') jauh lebih dihargai daripada klise hafalan.

drills.prompt: What is the minimum word target for IELTS Writing Task 2?
options: 250 words
150 words
200 words
400 words
drills.answer: 250 words
drills.explanation: Task 2 menuntut minimal 250 kata.

modules.title: IELTS Speaking Parts 1, 2 & 3: Fluency, Cue Card & Abstract Analysis
modules.objective: Mengembangkan jawaban alami pada Part 1, monolog 1–2 menit terstruktur pada Part 2 Cue Card, dan argumen analitis pada Part 3.
modules.theory: Empat kriteria IELTS Speaking (11–14 menit): Fluency & Coherence (FC), Lexical Resource (LR), Grammatical Range & Accuracy (GRA), dan Pronunciation (P). Pada Part 2, manfaatkan 1 menit persiapan untuk mencatat kata kunci cerita (setting, kejadian inti, dampak) agar bicara lancar 1.5–2 menit tanpa kehabisan bahan. Di Part 3, bahas tren masyarakat secara umum, bukan semata pengalaman pribadi.
modules.workedExample: Part 3 'Why do historic neighborhoods attract tourists?' -> Jawab dari sisi arsitektur unik, identitas budaya lokal, dan keseimbangan vs kepadatan turis.
modules.commonMistake: Berhenti bicara pada detik ke-35 di Part 2 atau menjawab Part 3 dengan cerita pribadi pendek saja.
modules.audioScript: Describe a public library or study space you visited recently. Explain where it was, why you went there, and what made it useful.

drills.prompt: During IELTS Speaking Part 2, how long do you have to prepare notes and how long should you speak?
options: 1 minute preparation, 1–2 minutes speaking
5 minutes preparation, 30 seconds speaking
No preparation, 5 minutes speaking
2 minutes preparation, 10 minutes speaking
drills.answer: 1 minute preparation, 1–2 minutes speaking
drills.explanation: Format resmi IELTS Part 2 memberi 1 menit persiapan dengan catatan dan 1–2 menit monolog.

drills.prompt: How does IELTS Speaking Part 3 differ from Part 1?
options: Part 3 shifts from personal daily habits to broader, abstract societal discussions.
Part 3 tests spelling through written dictation.
Part 3 only asks your hometown and favorite food.
Part 3 allows reading directly from a printed essay.
drills.answer: Part 3 shifts from personal daily habits to broader, abstract societal discussions.
drills.explanation: Part 3 menggali analisis konsep abstrak, perbandingan generasi, kebijakan, dan sebab-akibat sosial.

drills.prompt: Which habit improves Fluency & Coherence without risking memorized-speech penalties?
options: Using natural signposting ('Looking back', 'On the other hand') while extending answers with brief reasons
Reciting a memorized 200-word script regardless of the examiner's question
Answering every question with 'Yes' or 'No' only
Speaking as fast as possible without pausing between clauses
drills.answer: Using natural signposting ('Looking back', 'On the other hand') while extending answers with brief reasons
drills.explanation: Pengembangan ide alami dan kohesi wacana lebih bernilai daripada kecepatan bicara ekstrem atau hafalan.

modules.title: Listening Part A: Conditionals, Wishes, Advice & Passive Reversals
modules.objective: Mengidentifikasi kenyataan tersirat di balik kalimat pengandaian (wish/if-clause), saran tidak langsung, dan pergeseran aktif-pasif pada dialog ITP.
modules.theory: Mengacu modul mendengarkan OER (MB-OER-LST-02 & MB-OER-GRAM-02): konstruksi wish/unreal conditional menyatakan kebalikan dari fakta saat ini atau lampau. Misalnya 'I wish my advisor were here' bermakna pembimbing sedang tidak berada di tempat. Pada pola saran ('Why don't we...', 'Had you considered...'), jawaban tepat merefleksikan tindakan yang diusulkan, bukan penolakan harfiah.
modules.workedExample: Man: 'Did Dr. Alvarez sign your lab requisition?' Woman: 'If only she had checked her inbox before noon.' -> Jawaban: Dr. Alvarez has not signed the form yet.
modules.commonMistake: Mengartikan kata kerja positif sesudah 'wish' atau 'if only' sebagai kejadian yang benar-benar terlaksana.
modules.audioScript: M: Did you submit the budget form on time? W: Had I seen the deadline email yesterday, I wouldn't be waiting in line today.

drills.prompt: Woman: 'If I had backed up my slides earlier, I wouldn't be panicking now.' — What does the woman mean?
options: She forgot to save a backup copy of her slides earlier.
She already presented her slides without difficulty.
She plans to skip saving backups in the future.
She lent her laptop backup drive to a classmate.
drills.answer: She forgot to save a backup copy of her slides earlier.
acceptedAnswers: She forgot to save a backup copy of her slides earlier.
drills.explanation: Past unreal conditional ('If I had backed up...') menyiratkan tindakan pencadangan tidak terjadi.

drills.prompt: Man: 'Where is the quarterly climate bulletin?' Woman: 'Didn't Maya put it in the top drawer?' — What does the woman imply?
options: She thinks Maya probably stored the bulletin in the top drawer.
She insists Maya never reads climate bulletins.
She wants the man to buy a new filing cabinet.
She removed the folder from Maya's desk.
drills.answer: She thinks Maya probably stored the bulletin in the top drawer.
acceptedAnswers: She thinks Maya probably stored the bulletin in the top drawer.
drills.explanation: Negative question 'Didn't X do Y?' mengekspresikan ekspektasi atau ingatan bahwa hal tersebut sudah dilakukan.

drills.prompt: Woman: 'The bus to the observatory only runs every two hours.' Man: 'Looks like we'd better grab a taxi instead.' — What do they decide?
options: Take a taxi to save waiting time.
Wait two hours inside the observatory lobby.
Cancel their observatory visit altogether.
Walk along the highway with heavy tripods.
drills.answer: Take a taxi to save waiting time.
acceptedAnswers: Take a taxi to save waiting time.
drills.explanation: 'Had better + V1' menandai rekomendasi kuat atas solusi alternatif.

modules.title: Structure: Gerunds, Infinitives, Modals & Participial Reductions
modules.objective: Menguasai perbedaan objek gerund (-ing) vs infinitive (to + V1), bentuk modal pasif (MB-OER-GRAM-01/02), dan klausa partisipial ringkas.
modules.theory: Berdasarkan Bab 2.4 High-Intermediate Academic Grammar ESL (CC BY 4.0) dan ESOL Advanced Grammar Ch. 4: kata kerja tertentu wajib diikuti gerund (avoid, consider, suggest, enjoy), sedangkan yang lain menuntut infinitive (decide, refuse, manage). Dalam kalimat pasif bermodal, pakai pola 'modal + be + V3' (can be recycled, must be verified). Klausa sifat aktif dapat diringkas menjadi present participle (-ing) dan pasif menjadi past participle (-ed/V3).
modules.workedExample: Prompt: 'The specimens ___ in liquid nitrogen remained viable for three years.' -> 'stored' (reduksi klausa pasif 'which were stored').
modules.commonMistake: Memakai bentuk aktif '-ing' atau kata kerja berhingga ganda tanpa penghubung klausa.

drills.prompt: Geologists avoided ___ core samples near the fractured fault line until tremor activity subsided.
options: drilling
to drill
drilled
drill
drills.answer: drilling
acceptedAnswers: drilling
drills.explanation: Kata kerja 'avoid' selalu diikuti bentuk gerund (-ing), bukan to-infinitive.

drills.prompt: Deep-water coral data collected by remote submersibles must ___ before publication.
options: be calibrated
calibrating
calibrated
to calibrate
drills.answer: be calibrated
acceptedAnswers: be calibrated
drills.explanation: Struktur pasif setelah modal 'must' memerlukan 'be + past participle' (MB-OER-GRAM-02 Ch. 4.1.3).

drills.prompt: ___ from satellite altimetry, Arctic sea-ice thickness charts reveal long-term thinning trends.
options: Derived
Deriving
To derive
They derived
drills.answer: Derived
acceptedAnswers: Derived
drills.explanation: Partisipial pembuka merujuk pada subjek 'charts' yang bersifat pasif ('yang diturunkan dari...').

modules.title: Written Expression: Prepositional Idioms, Determiners & Parallel Clauses
modules.objective: Menemukan kesalahan halus pada preposisi terikat, kata sandang/kuantifier (count vs noncount), dan kesetaraan konstruksi klausa.
modules.theory: Mengacu ESL Grammar (MB-OER-GRAM-03 Ch. 2.6 & Ch. 4.13): periksa pasangan preposisi wajib (consist of, depend on, capable of, responsible for), kuantifier benda tak terhitung (much/less/amount of vs many/fewer/number of), serta keseimbangan bentuk dalam pasangan korrelatif (both A and B, not only A but also B, neither A nor B).
modules.workedExample: Prompt: 'The expedition carried [A] lesser drinking water [B] than planned [C] due to [D] leaking canisters.' -> [A] lesser (seharusnya less).
modules.commonMistake: Tertukar antara 'amount of' (noncount) vs 'number of' (jamak terhitung), atau menggunakan 'despite of'.

drills.prompt: Select the underlined error: 'Ocean salinity [A] depends primarily [B] in evaporation rates, [C] river discharge, and [D] seasonal ice melt.'
options: [A] depends
[B] in evaporation rates
[C] river discharge
[D] seasonal ice melt
drills.answer: [B] in evaporation rates
acceptedAnswers: [B] in evaporation rates
drills.explanation: Kata kerja 'depend' berpasangan dengan preposisi 'on/upon', bukan 'in'.

drills.prompt: ___ the high pressure two kilometers below sea level, chemosynthetic tube worms thrive beside hydrothermal vents.
options: Despite
Although
Because
Even
drills.answer: Despite
acceptedAnswers: Despite
drills.explanation: Setelah 'Despite' langsung diikuti frasa nomina; 'Although' memerlukan klausa (S + V).

drills.prompt: Select the underlined error: 'An [A] increasing amount of [B] coastal municipalities [C] are adopting permeable [D] pavement standards.'
options: [A] increasing amount of
[B] coastal municipalities
[C] are adopting
[D] pavement standards
drills.answer: [A] increasing amount of
acceptedAnswers: [A] increasing amount of
drills.explanation: 'Municipalities' adalah benda jamak terhitung sehingga harus menggunakan 'number of', bukan 'amount of'.

modules.title: Reading Academic Synthesis: Science Processes & Author Organization
modules.objective: Mengidentifikasi struktur organisasi bacaan ilmiah (klasifikasi, sebab-akibat, kronologi) dan mengevaluasi soal kecuali (NOT/EXCEPT) pada teks ITP 300+ kata.
modules.theory: Menggunakan kerangka bacaan ilmiah domain publik NOAA & NASA (MB-OER-SCI-01 & MB-OER-SCI-02): bacaan sains ITP sering membandingkan sistem lama vs mekanisme baru (mis. terumbu karang dangkal vs karang laut dalam yang hidup tanpa zooxanthellae fotosintetik). Pada pertanyaan 'Which of the following is NOT mentioned?', eliminasi 3 opsi yang memiliki padanan parafrase eksplisit di paragraf terkait.
modules.workedExample: Passage fact: Deep-sea corals filter organic detritus rather than relying on photosynthetic algae -> Opsi salah: 'They require bright sunlight for algal symbiosis.'
modules.commonMistake: Terjebak opsi yang benar menurut pengetahuan umum tetapi tidak tercantum di teks, atau keliru memilih pengecualian.

drills.prompt: Passage: 'Unlike tropical reef corals that depend on sunlit algae, deep-sea corals survive in dark waters by capturing drifting organic particles.' How do deep-sea corals obtain nutrition?
options: By trapping suspended organic debris from ocean currents
Through symbiotic photosynthesis in shallow lagoons
By absorbing geothermal sulfur from continental shelves
Through seasonal migration to warmer surfaces
drills.answer: By trapping suspended organic debris from ocean currents
acceptedAnswers: By trapping suspended organic debris from ocean currents
drills.explanation: 'Capturing drifting organic particles' diparafrasakan oleh 'trapping suspended organic debris'.

drills.prompt: Which paragraph transition signal most clearly introduces a competing scientific explanation?
options: Conversely, subsequent radiocarbon dating indicated...
In summary, these specimens shared four traits...
For instance, one specimen measured 14 centimeters...
Similarly, neighboring basins displayed identical clay...
drills.answer: Conversely, subsequent radiocarbon dating indicated...
acceptedAnswers: Conversely, subsequent radiocarbon dating indicated...
drills.explanation: 'Conversely' menandai pertentangan atau penjelasan tandingan.

drills.prompt: When answering a 'Where in the passage does the author describe X?' question, what is the fastest accurate verification?
options: Scan topic sentences and confirm the exact line span containing concrete evidence for X
Guess based on whether X sounds introductory or concluding
Pick the longest paragraph automatically
Assume all dates appear in Paragraph 1
drills.answer: Scan topic sentences and confirm the exact line span containing concrete evidence for X
acceptedAnswers: Scan topic sentences and confirm the exact line span containing concrete evidence for X
drills.explanation: Soal lokasi baris menuntut kecocokan fakta eksplisit pada rentang baris tertentu.

modules.title: iBT 2026 Reading Mastery: Morphological Clues in Complete the Words
modules.objective: Memprediksi bentuk kata yang hilang pada format C-test iBT 2026 lewat analisis akar kata, sufiks kelas kata, dan kolokasi akademik.
modules.theory: Mengacu Spesifikasi ETS iBT Jan 2026 (MB-REF-IBT-01) dan ESL 304 (MB-OER-READ-01): pada tugas Complete the Words, setengah huruf akhir kata disembunyikan (mis. 'infra___' atau 'signif___'). Cek: (1) penanda gramatikal sebelum/sesudah rumpang ('will + V1', 'the + N + of', 'increasingly + Adv/Adj'), (2) jumlah huruf/makna logis paragraf, dan (3) kesesuaian bentuk tunggal/jamak atau kala waktu.
modules.workedExample: Context: 'Volcanic ash layers allow archaeologists to estab___ reliable dates.' -> 'establish' (bentuk dasar setelah infinitive marker 'to').
modules.commonMistake: Mengisi kata benda atau adjektiva di posisi yang menuntut verba transitif atau adverbia.

drills.prompt: Complete the Word: 'Sensors trans___ real-time salinity measurements from moorings to coastal servers.' (Full verb)
drills.answer: transmit
acceptedAnswers: transmit
transfer
drills.explanation: Subjek jamak 'Sensors' butuh verb dasar 'transmit' sesuai konteks pengiriman data.

drills.prompt: Complete the Word: 'The museum requires visitors to make an ad___ reservation before entering the manuscript vault.' (Full adjective meaning made beforehand)
drills.answer: advance
acceptedAnswers: advance
drills.explanation: 'An advance reservation' adalah kolokasi baku bermakna reservasi yang dipesan lebih dulu.

drills.prompt: In 'Read in Daily Life', which cue most frequently signals an exception to a general campus rule?
options: 'Unless', 'except for', or bolded effective dates
'Congratulations' or 'Welcome back'
Font size of the university crest
The sender's street ZIP code alone
drills.answer: 'Unless', 'except for', or bolded effective dates
acceptedAnswers: 'Unless', 'except for', or bolded effective dates
drills.explanation: Soal Daily Life menguji ketelitian memahami syarat, batas waktu, dan pengecualian kebijakan.

modules.title: iBT 2026 Listening Mastery: Pragmatic Function & Speaker Attitude
modules.objective: Menilai maksud pragmatis kalimat singkat ('Why does the professor say...?') dan menyaring pilihan respons alami pada Listen & Choose a Response.
modules.theory: Berdasarkan kerangka konstruksi iBT RR-106 (MB-REF-IBT-03) dan teknik mendengarkan aktif CC-BY (MB-OER-LSPK-01): ujaran tidak selalu bermakna literal. Nada turun naik, ragu ('Wait—are you sure about Friday?'), atau jeda pendek menandakan koreksi atau penolakan sopan. Pada pengumuman/kuliah iBT 2026 yang ringkas, catat perubahan ruang, syarat prasyarat, serta contoh konkret yang mengilustrasikan teori utama.
modules.workedExample: Speaker: 'Hold on, didn't the dean reschedule the lab audit to Thursday morning?' -> Tujuan: Express doubt about the listener's Friday schedule.
modules.commonMistake: Memilih jawaban yang hanya cocok dengan satu kata kunci awal tanpa melihat fungsi tanya/ekspresi penutur.
modules.audioScript: W: Should we reserve Studio B for Thursday's recording? M: Actually, the acoustic engineer booked Studio B all afternoon, so let's switch to Studio C.

drills.prompt: A classmate asks: 'Mind if I borrow the reference atlas for ten minutes?' Which response clearly grants permission?
options: Go right ahead—I'm finished with that section.
Yes, I mind very much if anyone opens it.
I visited the downtown bookstore yesterday afternoon.
No, the geography exam isn't until March.
drills.answer: Go right ahead—I'm finished with that section.
acceptedAnswers: Go right ahead—I'm finished with that section.
drills.explanation: Ungkapan ramah 'Go right ahead' mengizinkan peminjaman secara alami.

drills.prompt: In a lecture, the professor says: 'Before you think glaciers move smoothly like slow rivers, remember they also fracture violently along fault planes.' Why does the professor mention 'slow rivers'?
options: To contrast a common intuition with sudden brittle sliding behavior
To prove all glaciers turn into warm rivers each summer
To explain municipal flood-wall construction
To introduce marine coral habitats
drills.answer: To contrast a common intuition with sudden brittle sliding behavior
acceptedAnswers: To contrast a common intuition with sudden brittle sliding behavior
drills.explanation: Berdasarkan temuan NASA glacier dynamics (MB-OER-SCI-02), dosen membantah anggapan gerak mulus seragam dengan retakan tiba-tiba.

drills.prompt: Which note-taking strategy works best in shorter 2026 iBT Listening talks?
options: Abbreviate main concepts, arrows for cause/effect (->), and mark self-corrections (*)
Try to transcribe every full preposition word-for-word
Wait until the audio ends completely before checking prompts
Ignore lecturer emphasis phrases like 'Crucially...'
drills.answer: Abbreviate main concepts, arrows for cause/effect (->), and mark self-corrections (*)
acceptedAnswers: Abbreviate main concepts, arrows for cause/effect (->), and mark self-corrections (*)
drills.explanation: Singkatan & simbol alur menjaga perhatian pada hubungan logika antaride.

modules.title: iBT 2026 Writing Mastery: Syntax Assembly, Email Register & Discussion Synthesis
modules.objective: Membangun struktur klausa majemuk bebas error pada Build a Sentence dan menulis balasan email kampus serta diskusi akademik iBT 2026 yang terfokus.
modules.theory: Merujuk Iowa State Academic Writing (MB-OER-WRITE-01) dan spesifikasi ETS 2026: (1) Pada Build a Sentence, hindari inversi pada embedded question ('Do you know when the lab opens?', bukan 'when does the lab open'); (2) Pada Write an Email (~70-120 kata), pakai sapaan sopan, tujuan jelas di kalimat awal, rincian alasan/jadwal spesifik, dan penutup ramah; (3) Pada Academic Discussion (~100-130 kata), bangun argumen orisinal yang merespons rekan kelas dengan bukti konkret.
modules.workedExample: Prompt fragments: ['wondered', 'whether', 'I', 'reviewed', 'you', 'the budget'] -> 'I wondered whether you reviewed the budget.'
modules.commonMistake: Melupakan kesepakatan subject-verb atau memakai register terlalu santai dalam email akademik ke profesor.

drills.prompt: Which embedded question word order is grammatically correct for Build a Sentence?
options: Could you tell me where the archival records are stored?
Could you tell me where are the archival records stored?
Could you tell me stored where are archival records?
Tell could you me archival where records are stored?
drills.answer: Could you tell me where the archival records are stored?
acceptedAnswers: Could you tell me where the archival records are stored?
drills.explanation: Embedded wh-clause di dalam kalimat tanya mengikuti urutan S + V biasa ('the archival records are stored').

drills.prompt: When writing an academic email to request a lab extension under the 2026 iBT format, which element is essential?
options: Explicit reason, specific proposed new date, and respectful closing
At least three informal emojis to sound friendly
Copying the exact prompt instructions twice to increase length
Using all capital letters in the subject line
drills.answer: Explicit reason, specific proposed new date, and respectful closing
acceptedAnswers: Explicit reason, specific proposed new date, and respectful closing
drills.explanation: Rubrik email menilai kelengkapan poin tugas, kejelasan komunikasi, dan ketepatan register sopan.

drills.prompt: In Write for an Academic Discussion, how do you demonstrate critical engagement?
options: Refer specifically to a peer's claim, add a fresh supporting/counter example, and avoid verbatim prompt copying
State 'I agree with both students' and stop after 40 words
Switch to an unrelated anecdote from primary school
Use bullet fragments without complete sentences
drills.answer: Refer specifically to a peer's claim, add a fresh supporting/counter example, and avoid verbatim prompt copying
acceptedAnswers: Refer specifically to a peer's claim, add a fresh supporting/counter example, and avoid verbatim prompt copying
drills.explanation: Elaborasi logis dan keterhubungan dengan diskusi rekan adalah indikator utama skor tinggi.

modules.title: iBT 2026 Speaking Mastery: Phonological Chunking & Rapid Interview Framing
modules.objective: Menjaga akurasi pengulangan frasa pada Listen & Repeat dan membangun jawaban terstruktur dalam wawancara beruntun 45 detik.
modules.theory: Mengacu Pronunciation CC-BY (MB-OER-LSPK-01 Ch. 1.2) dan rubrik iBT Speaking 2026: pada 7 tugas Listen & Repeat, tahan memori kerja dengan membagi kalimat menjadi 2-3 kelompok makna (subject phrase | verb+object | prepositional ending). Pada 4 pertanyaan Take an Interview tanpa waktu persiapan panjang, jawab langsung tesis di 5 detik pertama, tambah 1 alasan mekanisme, lalu tutup dengan contoh nyata singkat.
modules.workedExample: Listen & Repeat chunking: '[Due to heavy snowfall] / [all shuttle buses will depart] / [from the west transit hub.]'
modules.commonMistake: Berhenti total di tengah kalimat atau bergumam terlalu lama saat mencoba mengingat satu kata tepat.

drills.prompt: What is the most effective memory strategy for long sentences in TOEFL iBT 2026 'Listen and Repeat'?
options: Group words into 2–3 syntactic meaning chunks and mirror the speaker's stress rhythm
Focus only on memorizing the first two words and guess the ending
Speak in monotone staccato syllables with equal gaps
Insert extra introductory filler phrases like 'Um, well, he said that...'
drills.answer: Group words into 2–3 syntactic meaning chunks and mirror the speaker's stress rhythm
acceptedAnswers: Group words into 2–3 syntactic meaning chunks and mirror the speaker's stress rhythm
drills.explanation: Chunking sintaktis memperluas kapasitas memori jangka pendek sekaligus menjaga inteligibilitas.

drills.prompt: During 'Take an Interview', you get a question on urban public transit funding. Which opening works strongest?
options: 'I strongly support expanding electric bus corridors because they cut commuter delays and urban emissions.'
'Wait... urban transit... let me think about cars and bikes for twenty seconds...'
'Good morning distinguished examiner, today I shall discuss a controversial topic since time immemorial.'
'Yes.' (pause 15 seconds)
drills.answer: 'I strongly support expanding electric bus corridors because they cut commuter delays and urban emissions.'
acceptedAnswers: 'I strongly support expanding electric bus corridors because they cut commuter delays and urban emissions.'
drills.explanation: Posisi jelas + dua alasan ringkas langsung membuka alur penjelasan yang terarah.

drills.prompt: Which factor does NOT help Speaking intelligibility in automated or local rubric checks?
options: Rushing words at >220 WPM while swallowing consonant endings
Maintaining steady pacing around 130–160 WPM with clear word stress
Self-correcting cleanly if a minor plural slips
Linking function words naturally between stressed content words
drills.answer: Rushing words at >220 WPM while swallowing consonant endings
acceptedAnswers: Rushing words at >220 WPM while swallowing consonant endings
drills.explanation: Kecepatan ekstrem mengorbankan kejelasan konsonan akhir dan tekanan kata.

modules.title: IELTS Listening Mastery: Signposting, Numbers, Dates & Multiple-Speaker Part 3
modules.objective: Memetakan transisi Part 1–4, menulis angka/tanggal/ejaan secara presisi, dan membedakan kesepakatan akhir antara 2–3 pembicara akademik di Part 3.
modules.theory: Mengacu materi pendengaran CC-BY (MB-OER-LST-02 & MB-OER-LSPK-01): di IELTS Listening, penomoran soal hampir selalu berurutan sesuai aliran rekaman. Perhatikan jebakan self-correction di Part 1 (mis. kode pos/biaya/hari), rujukan peta atau klasifikasi di Part 2, dan pergantian persetujuan di Part 3 ('I thought X, though your graph actually proves Y'). Pada Part 4, kata pengisi rumpang persis seperti terdengar di audio tanpa mengubah kelas kata.
modules.workedExample: Audio Part 3: Mia: 'Let's include sample sizes above 200.' Leo: 'Actually, budget limits us to 85 households, though adding follow-up interviews balances depth.' -> Agreed constraint: 85 households with interviews.
modules.commonMistake: Menulis jawaban melebihi batas instruksi ('ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER') atau memasukkan artikel ('the/a') saat batas hanya satu kata.
modules.audioScript: M: For our soil seminar, I originally drafted twelve survey pages. W: That's far too long for busy farmers—if we trim it to three concise sections, response rates will double. M: Good point, let's lock three sections.

drills.prompt: Instruction says: 'Write ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER'. Audio: 'We meet in Hall three, room fourteen.' Which answer violates the word/number rule?
options: in fourteen / room number 14
fourteen
Hall 3
drills.answer: in fourteen / room number 14
acceptedAnswers: in fourteen / room number 14
drills.explanation: Batas ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER mengizinkan maksimal satu kata plus satu angka; frasa tiga kata langsung dianggap salah.

drills.prompt: In IELTS Part 3, Tutor says: 'Your questionnaire design was ambitious, wasn't it?' Student replies: 'Too broad, really—we should tighten it to three core variables.' What do they agree?
options: Narrow the survey scope to three core variables.
Expand the questionnaire with twenty new sections.
Delete the entire survey method from Chapter 2.
Print posters before finalizing the questions.
drills.answer: Narrow the survey scope to three core variables.
acceptedAnswers: Narrow the survey scope to three core variables.
drills.explanation: Evaluasi kritis mengarah ke keputusan penyempitan cakupan.

drills.prompt: Before IELTS Listening Part 4 begins, how should you use the 30–40 second preview window?
options: Predict the required part of speech (singular noun, verb, adjective) around each gap
Read back through Part 1 answers without looking at Part 4 prompts
Try to memorize all 10 distractors verbatim
Close your eyes until the lecturer says 'Good morning'
drills.answer: Predict the required part of speech (singular noun, verb, adjective) around each gap
acceptedAnswers: Predict the required part of speech (singular noun, verb, adjective) around each gap
drills.explanation: Prediksi kelas kata membuat telinga otomatis menangkap kata target saat rekaman berputar.

modules.title: IELTS Reading: Matching Features, Researcher Claims & Paraphrase Mining
modules.objective: Menjodohkan pernyataan ke peneliti/institusi atau tahun tepat dan menelusuri padanan sinonim ilmiah dalam bacaan IELTS 600–800 kata.
modules.theory: Merujuk keterampilan membaca EAP & artikel ilmiah publik (MB-OER-READ-01, MB-OER-SCI-01/02): teknik tercepat untuk Matching Features adalah memindai teks hanya untuk menandai nama peneliti/lembaga (mis. Dr. Nair, NOAA, University of Graz) lalu membaca 2–4 kalimat tepat di sekitar nama tersebut. Cocokkan makna dengan daftar klaim menggunakan sinonim konseptual, bukan kesamaan satu kata identik.
modules.workedExample: Text: 'Sauber and Molnia reported that rapid ice thinning reduces overburden pressure along Alaskan coastal faults.' -> Matches statement linking glacier melt to seismic fault instability.
modules.commonMistake: Terhenti di kata pertama yang muncul beberapa kali tanpa memeriksa peneliti mana yang benar-benar menyatakan klaim itu.

drills.prompt: Text excerpt: 'While early oceanographers believed corals only grew above 100 meters, NOAA submersibles documented living cold-water reefs 2,000 meters deep.' What misconception was overturned?
options: That coral ecosystems are strictly confined to shallow sunlit depths
That oceanographers had never used submarines before 2025
That deep-sea corals grow faster in boiling tropical vents
That coastal storms never affect shallow ecosystems
drills.answer: That coral ecosystems are strictly confined to shallow sunlit depths
acceptedAnswers: That coral ecosystems are strictly confined to shallow sunlit depths
drills.explanation: 'Only grew above 100 meters' setara dengan terbatas pada perairan dangkal.

drills.prompt: When solving 'Matching Information to Paragraphs (A–F)', remember that...
options: Some paragraphs may contain more than one answer while others contain none (if stated in instructions)
Paragraph A always matches Question 1 sequentially
You must use every paragraph letter once even without a note saying so
Only read the very last word of each paragraph
drills.answer: Some paragraphs may contain more than one answer while others contain none (if stated in instructions)
acceptedAnswers: Some paragraphs may contain more than one answer while others contain none (if stated in instructions)
drills.explanation: Berbeda dengan Matching Headings, Matching Information mengizinkan penggunaan ulang huruf bila instruksi menyebut NB.

drills.prompt: In IELTS Reading YES / NO / NOT GIVEN, what does 'NO' strictly evaluate?
options: Whether a statement contradicts the writer's expressed view or claim
Whether the reader personally disagrees with the topic
Whether the statement mentions statistics not found anywhere in the passage
Whether the statement uses British instead of American spelling
drills.answer: Whether a statement contradicts the writer's expressed view or claim
acceptedAnswers: Whether a statement contradicts the writer's expressed view or claim
drills.explanation: YNNG mengukur klaim/pandangan penulis, dan 'NO' menandakan kontradiksi langsung terhadap sikap penulis.

modules.title: IELTS Writing Band 7–8 Precision: Data Verbs, Complex Clauses & Hedging
modules.objective: Meningkatkan skor Lexical Resource & Grammatical Range pada Task 1 dan Task 2 mengacu langsung Deskriptor Band IELTS resmi.
modules.theory: Mengacu IELTS Writing Band Descriptors (MB-REF-IELTS-01) dan Iowa State Academic Writing (MB-OER-WRITE-01): kriteria Band 7–8 mensyaratkan 'a variety of complex structures' dan kalimat bebas-error yang sering, plus 'skillful use of uncommon/collocational items'. Di Task 1, ganti pengulangan 'went up' dengan 'rose sharply / experienced a modest rebound / plateaued at'. Di Task 2, hindari generalisasi mutlak ('always ruins society') dengan academic hedging ('tends to erode', 'may exacerbate', 'depending on regulatory oversight').
modules.workedExample: Weak: 'Solar power increased bigly and everyone likes it.' -> Band 7.5+: 'Solar output rose sharply from 14% to 38%, whereas coal consumption declined steadily across the decade.'
modules.commonMistake: Memakai idiom informal percakapan ('every coin has two sides', 'nowadays people think') atau memaksakan kata langka yang salah konteks.

drills.prompt: Which Task 1 sentence shows the clearest high-band comparative accuracy and cohesion?
options: Whereas municipal rail ridership climbed by 24% between 2015 and 2024, private car commuting fell marginally by 6%.
Train up 24% and car down 6% in table.
Everyone stopped driving cars because trains are awesome and popular everywhere.
In 2015 trains 24% and then in 2024 it increased to good numbers.
drills.answer: Whereas municipal rail ridership climbed by 24% between 2015 and 2024, private car commuting fell marginally by 6%.
acceptedAnswers: Whereas municipal rail ridership climbed by 24% between 2015 and 2024, private car commuting fell marginally by 6%.
drills.explanation: Kontras klausa subordinator 'Whereas...' membandingkan dua tren disertai angka presisi.

drills.prompt: Which revision demonstrates appropriate academic hedging in IELTS Writing Task 2?
options: Remote work policies can improve retention, provided firms maintain structured onboarding for junior staff.
Remote work ALWAYS makes EVERY worker 100% happier without any flaw.
Working from home is super good and companies are silly if they dislike it.
There are pros and cons to working from home in this modern globe today.
drills.answer: Remote work policies can improve retention, provided firms maintain structured onboarding for junior staff.
acceptedAnswers: Remote work policies can improve retention, provided firms maintain structured onboarding for junior staff.
drills.explanation: Hedging + kondisi ('can improve..., provided...') mencerminkan analisis bernuansa Band 7–8.

drills.prompt: According to public Task 1 Band Descriptors, what caps Task Achievement around Band 5 if missing?
options: Absence of a clear Overview summarizing key trends/stages
Writing 165 words instead of 220 words
Using American spelling consistently
Writing numbers like '42%' instead of 'forty-two per cent'
drills.answer: Absence of a clear Overview summarizing key trends/stages
acceptedAnswers: Absence of a clear Overview summarizing key trends/stages
drills.explanation: Deskriptor Task 1 menyebut secara eksplisit ketiadaan Overview membatasi skor Task Achievement.

modules.title: IELTS Speaking Pronunciation & Part 3 Analytical Extension
modules.objective: Mengatur intonasi penekanan makna, keterhubungan ucapan (connected speech), dan perluasan jawaban abstrak Part 3 sesuai Speaking Band Descriptors.
modules.theory: Merujuk IELTS Speaking Band Descriptors (MB-REF-IELTS-02) dan modul Pronunciation LibreTexts (MB-OER-LSPK-01 Ch. 1.2): Pronunciation Band 7+ menuntut pengendalian fitur fonologis berkelanjutan—termasuk sentence stress pada kata kontras ('NOT just cheaper, but SAFER') dan pelafalan gugus konsonan akhir. Saat mendapat pertanyaan sulit di Part 3, pakai rumus PEEL lisan: Posisi ringkas -> Mekanisme sebab-akibat -> Dampak sosial -> Pengecualian singkat.
modules.workedExample: Question: 'Why do older architectural landmarks still matter in rapidly expanding cities?' -> Frame: Heritage identity (point) -> shared civic memory across generations (mechanism) -> balancing preservation vs housing needs (nuance).
modules.commonMistake: Memberi jawaban 1 kalimat pendek lalu diam menunggu penguji memancing pertanyaan tambahan.

drills.prompt: In IELTS Speaking Part 3, if an examiner asks an unfamiliar policy question, what keeps Fluency & Coherence intact?
options: Buy 2 seconds naturally ('That's a nuanced issue; from an urban planning angle, I'd say...') then give a structured point + reason
Stay silent for 12 seconds then whisper 'I don't know'
Switch topic completely to describe your favorite childhood meal
Recite a memorized statistics list unrelated to the question
drills.answer: Buy 2 seconds naturally ('That's a nuanced issue; from an urban planning angle, I'd say...') then give a structured point + reason
acceptedAnswers: Buy 2 seconds naturally ('That's a nuanced issue; from an urban planning angle, I'd say...') then give a structured point + reason
drills.explanation: Penanda jeda alami menjaga kelancaran sambil menyusun argumen.

drills.prompt: Which feature directly raises IELTS Pronunciation clarity without requiring a native British or American accent?
options: Clear word stress, sentence-level contrast intonation, and steady phrasing chunks
Forcing an exaggerated slang accent that causes consonant drops
Speaking in whispers to hide grammar slips
Stressing every single syllable identically
drills.answer: Clear word stress, sentence-level contrast intonation, and steady phrasing chunks
acceptedAnswers: Clear word stress, sentence-level contrast intonation, and steady phrasing chunks
drills.explanation: Deskriptor Speaking menilai inteligibilitas, ritme, dan intonasi, bukan aksen daerah tertentu.

drills.prompt: Which four bullet habits turn a Part 2 Cue Card (2-minute monologue) from under-length into natural flow?
options: Brief setting -> step-by-step concrete incident -> sensory detail/feeling -> broader reflection on why it mattered
Repeating the prompt sentence ten times slowly
Listing isolated single adjectives without verbs
Counting out loud from one to sixty during prep minute
drills.answer: Brief setting -> step-by-step concrete incident -> sensory detail/feeling -> broader reflection on why it mattered
acceptedAnswers: Brief setting -> step-by-step concrete incident -> sensory detail/feeling -> broader reflection on why it mattered
drills.explanation: Alur naratif + refleksi akhir mudah mengisi 90–120 detik secara alami.
